formula: sqrt((sum_i w_i cos(2 theta_i))^2 + (sum_i w_i sin(2 theta_i))^2) / sum_i w_i

orientation.note: gradient orientation is perpendicular to local line orientation, but axial concentration is invariant to the 90-degree rotation

primary_pixel_inclusion.valid_region: full resized image excluding one-pixel perimeter

interpretation.higher: selected gradient energy is more concentrated in fewer axial directions
interpretation.lower: selected gradient energy is more dispersed across axial directions

sobel_normalization: divide by sqrt(2)*4*255 and clip to [0,1]

statistics.summary: image-level mean and sample SD (ddof=1), plus bootstrap mean CI and distribution statistics
statistics.pairwise: two-sided Mann-Whitney U with Holm adjustment within metric
